messages:
samir: quick PSA — ran the weekly access-snapshot, found 4 admin principals with zero last_login and no service bindings. calling them 'ghost admins'. starting triage now.

jess: can you paste the ARNs/IDs? i'll run an entitlement check.

samir: here's the scrubbed list (no real emails):
```
- svc-admin-0293 (role)
- alice-temp-admin (user)
- ci-deploy-admin (svc)
- legacy-oncall-admin (user)
```
not sure if any are staged for deprovision.

olivia: sec-bot flagged ci-deploy-admin as recently used by the deploy pipeline at 2026-03-15 though — could be ephemeral key. @samir did you include key rotation/caller info?

sec-bot: automated-audit: found 1 KMS-encrypted credential usage for ci-deploy-admin at 2026-03-15T14:12:09Z; 0 console logins. Full record -> https://audit.example/rec/abc123

samir: thanks. that suggests service principal still active; i'll check service account bindings and KMS key policy.

kevin: quick note — when you make changes, follow the RBAC playbook stanza 3 for canary: remove entitlement from a non-prod binding first and monitor traces for 24h. we'll need a canary plan for each principal.

jess: +1. also add an entry to the incident tracker for potential orphaned keys. i'll open the ticket.

samir: created ticket <https://tracker.internal/SEC-4321> — steps: 1) snapshot bindings, 2) run `iam simulate-principal-policy` for each, 3) rotate or revoke keys, 4) audit KMS CMK grants, 5) deprovision after 48h observation. tagging @olivia @kevin.

olivia: for audit trail, make sure CloudTrail -> SIEM ingestion includes `userIdentity.principalId` so we can tie back. Also capture `kms:ViaService` fields.

kevin: if the principal is in a delegated project account, coordinate with infra on cross-account key grants. @samir add a note about cross-account trust in the ticket.

samir: done. i'm going to remove alice-temp-admin from prod IAM group as a canary today at 18:00 UTC and watch alerts. will post results here.

jess: thanks. one more ask — collect justification evidence (owner, ticket, last approving reviewer) before final deletion so we have recertification docs.

samir: noted. will attach to SEC-4321.

samir: UPDATE 18:45 UTC — removed alice-temp-admin from prod group; no alerts. CloudTrail shows no `ConsoleLogin` and only previous api calls from 2025-11. leaving for scheduled revoke in 48h.

olivia: looks good. assign to compliance for final signoff after 48h.

kevin: :thumbsup: remind oncall if any deploys use ci-deploy-admin during the window.

sec-bot: scheduled report: next weekly access-snapshot will include delta for SEC-4321; auto-attach logs.

samir: thanks all. closing loop once revokes complete.
